What brings you here? I didn't think we'd meet again so soon...
strings.따로 일이 있어서 온 건 아니고…. 그냥 큰 일이 하나 끝나면 그 지역에: Nothing in particular... Whenever something big ends, I seem to come back to the place where it happened.
strings.뭐, 그냥…. 그런데 벨레드는 왜 그래요?: Well, just... But what's wrong with you, Veled?
I don't know about anyone else, but I feel I should tell you.
strings.그동안 나 아름다움이나 인성이나 이런 게 부족하다고 절대 생각하지 않았: I never thought I lacked anything in beauty or character, but what happened made me realize something.
I'm incomplete. I need to become more whole.
Ordinary humans are like that too.
Really? But I'm different from them. I...
strings.고마워. 하여튼, 나 살아가면서 그 이유를 찾으면서 살 거야. 그래도: Thank you. Anyway, I'll go on living and searching for the reason. But I feel impatient. I know it won't be easy. Hmm...
strings.작은 거라도 좋으니 도움이 될만한 게 있을까…. 혹시 아드키나 님께 조언: Is there anything that might help, even a little...? Why not ask Lord Atkina for advice?
strings.아, 그걸 생각 못 했네. 아드키나 아저씨에게 좋은 이야기라도 들으면 괜: Oh, I hadn't thought of that. Hearing some wise words from Uncle Atkina might help.
strings.같이 가고 싶지만, 어쩌지?: I'd like to go with you, but there's a problem.
strings.나 용의 계곡에 못 가. 아드리카는 괜찮을 수도 있지만, 계곡 같이 깊은: I can't enter the Dragon Valley. Adrica might be all right, but deeper places like the valley recognize me as an unholy being and keep me out.
strings.그래서 아드키나 아저씨가 부르면 포보스랑 아드리카 경계에서 만나 수다를: So when Uncle Atkina calls for me, we meet at the border between Phobos and Adrica and chat...
Then it will have to be me. Someone has to go...
strings.네, 괜찮아요. 며칠 동안 용의 계곡에서 지내기로 해서 다시 가야 하긴: Not at all. I agreed to stay in the Dragon Valley for a few days, so I need to return anyway.
It's not urgent. Come tell me what he says when you have time. Then I can tell you about my beauty...
That's all right. I'll see you later.
strings.가버렸네, %s. 그나저나 항상 내 아름다움에 대한 이야기를 왜 사양하는: Off you go, %s. Why do you always turn down the chance to hear about my beauty?
I wondered where you had gone. You visited Veled.
Yes. I just felt like I should stop by Phobos. Oh, right. Veled...
strings.벨레드가 자신의 존재에 대해 많이 고민하고 있군. 모든 생명이 그렇듯이: Veled is giving considerable thought to her own existence. That is important for every living being.
strings.나도 도움이 됐으면 하는데, 드래곤이 할 수 있는 게 뭐가 있을지. 벨레: I would like to help, but what can a dragon do? If only Veled could feel more secure...
strings.벨레드가 아끼는 사람이 믿음을 약속하면 불안한 게 덜할 걸세. 나는 그런: If someone Veled cherishes pledges their trust in her, she will feel less anxious. The goddess is that person for me.
Yes. The person who just came to mind is the one you trust. Then the answer is simple.
strings.네, 그럴게요. 벨레드에게 그런 사람이면 피오니아겠네요. 아드키나 님도: All right. For Veled, that person would be Peonia. You know her too, don't you?
strings.들어서 알고는 있네. 강직한 아름다움을 가진, 포보스의 기운을 닮은 여성: I've heard of her. A woman of steadfast beauty who embodies the spirit of Phobos. She even scolds Valdrick without hesitation...
strings.피오니아 또한 벨레드에게 믿음이 있어야 하네. 내가 말한 물건을 구해 피: Peonia must also have trust in Veled. Bring her the item I name, and she will understand.
strings.심상세계에서만 구할 수 있는 '정령의 날개'란 것일세. 급한 건 아니니: A Spirit Wing, found only in the Inner World. There is no hurry. Take your time.
strings.(그걸 예전에 혼돈의 협곡에서 구한 것 같은데…. 일단 가볼까?): (I think I found one in the Chaos Canyon before... Shall I look there?)
strings.…어서 와. 조금 바쁘긴 하지만, 당신하고 이야기할 시간은 괜찮아. 금방: ...Welcome. I'm a little busy, but I have time to talk to you. I did expect we'd meet again soon...
Lord Atkina asked me to give you this...
strings.아드키나 님이면 초인…. 아니 용이시니 초룡이라고 하나. 그런데 이게 뭔: Atkina, the Champion...? Or should I say champion dragon? Anyway, what is it?
strings.피오니아가 이걸 받으면 알 수 있을 거라고 하시더군요. 정확히는 저도 몰: He said you'd understand when you received it. I don't know exactly what he meant...
strings.(피오니아가 %s의 손에 있는 정령의 날개를 빤히 바라보다 받는다.): (Peonia gazes at the Spirit Wing in %s's hand, then takes it.)
What's happening? The wing's moving on its own and flying away. That's where Veled is...
strings.잘은 모르지만, 내가 벨레드를 위해 뭔가 하면 되는 거야? 아드키나 님이: I don't quite understand, but am I supposed to do something for Veled? What did Atkina say?
Yes. He said you should pledge your trust in her.
I don't doubt Veled. But I want to show her I believe in her...
strings.증명하고 싶은 거군요. 말보다는 행동이나 물건으로 보여주는 게 더 좋은: You want to prove it. An action or a gift might express that better than words.
strings.벨레드가 가지고 있는 그 펜던트를 또 구할 수 있을까?: Could you find another pendant like the one Veled has?
strings.(아, 어쩌면…. 다른 공간이 있을지도 모르겠네. 비슷하면서도 다른….): (Oh, maybe... There could be another space. Similar, but different...)
strings.(데이나가 그랬었지. 내가 가서 찾아낸 것도 있을 거라고….): (Dayna said there might be things I only discovered because I went there...)
Is it difficult? You don't have to...
No, I think I can find one.
strings.부탁하신 물건 여기 있어요. 불길한 장소에서 찾아낸 거긴 하지만, 괜찮을: Here's what you asked for. I found it in an ominous place, but it should be safe.
I can't sense any power in it. It's simply an ornament, nothing more.
strings.(피오니아가 %s에게서 받은 펜던트를 착용한다.): (Peonia puts on the pendant she received from %s.)
When Veled wore it, I thought it was just an ordinary rose ornament.
Oh, thanks... As long as it helps Veled...
Anyway, thank you. I'm managing to sort out the aftermath of the mayor's actions, too...
strings.얼마 전에 빛의 연합에서 사람이 왔어. 그동안 끊겼던 교류를 이어가자고: Someone from the Alliance of Light came recently. They wanted to restore the ties we'd cut. It felt as though Lord Ziskad had been waiting for us...
strings.그래, 그게 느껴졌어. 그런데 클라우스 시장님은 대체 무슨 생각이셨을까…: Yes, I could tell. But what could Mayor Klaus have been thinking...?
I thought at least the side of him I knew had been real...
strings.저는 그분에 대해서 잘 모르지만, 다른 주민들은 뭐라고 하나요?: I don't know much about him, but what do the other residents say?
strings.반반이야. 시장님을 지지하던 사람은 그럴 사람이 아니라 그러고, 맘에 들: They're split down the middle. His supporters say he'd never do something like that. The people who disliked him say they knew it all along.
We have evidence and witnesses... It's just that the witnesses are Veled and Uncle Valdrick.
It's all right. I'll work it out somehow.
I'm sure you will, Peonia. It's reassuring.
strings.칭찬해줘서 고마워. 때가 되면 내가 벨레드에게 가서 이걸 보여줄게. 아드: Thank you for saying that. When the time is right, I'll visit Veled and show her this. Please thank Lord Atkina for me.
strings.(피오니아가 목에 걸린 펜던트를 들어 빤히 바라본다.): (Peonia lifts the pendant around her neck and stares at it.)
strings.피오니아, 너는 잘 할 거야. 널 믿고 의지하는 사람이 있으니까. 약해져: Peonia, you can do this. There are people who believe in you and depend on you. You mustn't falter. For everyone who trusts you...
strings.그런데 두 사람, 처음 뵙는데 해결사신가요? 당분간 몬스터와 악마 퇴치: By the way, I haven't seen you two before. Are you troubleshooters? We won't be posting monster or demon extermination requests for a while.
strings.아하하, 저희를 보셨군요. 어떻게 찾으셨지? 저희는 해결사가 아니고 보시: Ahaha. You noticed us? How did you spot us? We're not troubleshooters. As you can see...
A gift. Freshly made caramel cake.
strings.우리 이제 막 도착했는데, 대체 어떻게 한 거야?: We only just arrived. How did you manage that?
Let's call it a family secret. There's some for you too, Raclette. Eat as much as you like.
strings.난 단 거 싫어. 그래서 너랑 오기 싫었던 건데…. 그리고 집안이라고 하: I hate sweets. That's why I didn't want to come with you... And mentioning your family brings back things I'd rather forget. Sigh...
Enough of the comedy routine. Tell me why you've come.
strings.그러면 이야기가 빠르겠네요. 조용히 이야기할 수 있는 자리를 마련해주세요: That makes things easier. Please find somewhere we can talk privately.
